q1_issues.issue: "often" is a frequency adverb but is stored as (Manner sk_hang_out_1 often), the slot the instruction set reserves for how-adverbs, so the frequency claim survives only as a manner term and no frequency form records it.

q2_gaps: unquantified frequency adverbs ("often", "rarely", "frequently", "sometimes") — the Frequency & habitual schedules section provides only named calendar slots, (Every e n unit) periods and (TimesPer e n unit) rates, none of which accepts an adverb with no number or cycle
notes: The collective one-event/two-Agent form is defensible here because "hang out" is a reciprocal/aggregate predicate like "meet", and the phrasal verb is kept whole with no genus as required. The inception prose says both events take Past when past while its worked example marks only the aspectual verb; this parse follows the example.
